parsed.doc_summary: Boston.gov page on the Housing Stability Notification Act (Boston City Code § 10-11.7): landlords ending a tenancy must give a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources with the notice to quit or non-renewal, and report the notice to the City. The fine is up to $300 per day.

rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: A landlord ending a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources together with the notice to quit or notice of non-renewal. The landlord must also submit the tenant's contact information and a copy of the notice to the City through its online portal.
rules.key_value: Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources delivered with the notice to quit; copy submitted to the City
rules.quoted_span: The Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources should be delivered at the same time as the Notice to quit or Notice of non-renewal of lease.
rules.effective_date_note: The page gives no effective date.
rules.penalty: First offense: warning. Second and later offenses: $300 per day, enforced by the Inspectional Services Department. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to all landlords planning to end a tenancy.
